displayName: Screen applicants against a job description
summary: Compare CVs to requirements and flag the top matches with a short rationale.

useCases.title: Screen applicants against a job description
useCases.message: Help me screen a batch of applicants. Ask me for the job description and where to find the CVs. You might want to identify the three or four most important requirements from the role before comparing. Then review each application and give me a shortlist with a short note on each candidate explaining how their background compares to the role.
